species.name: Brown Trout
species.how: spin or fly from the shore at first and last light
notes: Lakes Wanaka, Hawea, Wakatipu and Dunstan are open all year (bag 2 trout + 4 salmon on the main lakes). Many rivers close 30 Apr, so check the Otago Fish & Game regulations. A licence is required.
sources: Fish & Game NZ, Otago winter fishing. https://www.fishandgame.org.nz/freshwater-fishing-in-new-zealand/where-to-fish/winter-fishing/otago/
